headlines.title: Airbnb CEO says travelers are about to see big changes
headlines.summary: Brian Chesky tried booking stays through AI assistants, and his verdict may sound very familiar.

headlines.title: Airbnb CEO: ChatGPT Traffic “Converts Better” Than Google’s. That’s a Problem for Alphabet
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAirbnb CEO Brian Chesky said this week that a lot of the traffic Airbnb gets from ChatGPT converts better than traffic from Google. That threatens the premium advertisers pay Google for high-intent search clicks, even before AI agents can book trips on their own.

headlines.title: Booking (BKNG) vs Airbnb (ABNB): Which is a Better Stock to Buy?
headlines.summary: Booking Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:BKNG) closed at $159.02 on October 2, and Airbnb, Inc. (NASDAQ:ABNB) at $162.43. The two share prices are almost identical. Over the past twelve months, one of them rose by a third, and the other fell by a quarter, and the one that fell is the more profitable business.

headlines.title: Jim Cramer Believes Airbnb (ABNB) “Is Mostly Insulated From AI Competition”
headlines.summary: When discussing the recent sell-off across online travel equities during the September 29 episode of Mad Money, Jim Cramer highlighted Airbnb, Inc. (NASDAQ:ABNB) as a standout buying opportunity.

headlines.title: Airbnb (ABNB) After KeyBanc Upgrade Are Hotel Growth Hopes Making Valuation Look Too Cheap
headlines.summary: KeyBanc’s recent upgrade of Airbnb (ABNB) to Overweight put fresh attention on the company’s hotel ambitions. This newer line of business could complement its core home-sharing marketplace for long-term growth. The recent upgrade lands after a mixed stretch for Airbnb’s share price, with a 22.12% year to date share price return and a 10.01% 90 day share price gain, offset by a 30 day move that declined 10.72%. description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
